page.layout: One page of running text, with running head at top and page number at top right. No margin notes. Numbered objections and replies run in paragraphs down the page, with Greek and Latin inline.

main_text.p: everti perseverantiam sanctorum, cum apostatæ[?] non fuerint veri sancti.
main_text.head: DIGRESSIO ἀνασκευαστικὴ[?], qua breviter respondeatur ad dicta & exempla Scripturæ in speciem contraria.
main_text.p: 1. Etiam vere sancti dicûtur prolabi. Hebr. 6. & 10.
Respon. 1. est comminatio conditionalis: Si prolabantur.
2. loquitur de temporariis, quorum fides, cum radicem non habeat: non est vera. Probetur ex textu, φωτισθέντας.[illegible, ~12 letters] : terra proferens spinas.
Amplificetur collatione hujus descriptionis hypocritarum cum illa Matt. 7. Domine, Domine, &c.
Item à contrario: quia apostolus ipse comminationem illam à sanctis removet: πεπεισμ[illegible, ~5 letters] δὲ [illegible, ~3 letters] ὑμῶν.
2. quia spem nostram vocat anchoram tutam ac firmam.
II. Etiam qui verè effugerant inquinamenta mundi rursus implicati superantur. 2. Pet. 2.
2. Loquitur de hypocritis: Probetur ex textu:
1. Vocat ψυχὰς ἀστηρίκτους etiam nondum inescatas[?], ver.14.
2. Tantum historicam fidem eis tribuit, quod ostendatur ex ver.18.20.21.
Resp. 1. Lectio varia: ὀλίγον, ὀλίγως, ὄν-τως pro ὄν-τως.

page.notes: Page number "206" is printed in old-style figures ("2o6"). The Greek in the Resp. 2 line (ψωτισθέντας passage, Heb. 6:7) and in the Heb. 6:9 line is only partly legible at this scan resolution, so those spans are marked illegible rather than guessed. "apostatæ", "ἀνασκευαστικὴ", "inescatas" and "ψυχὰς ἀστηρίκτους" are read with doubt. The second-line "ὄντως" at the lower right is a continuation of the lectio varia, printed to the right of the line. The catchword and signature are not printed.
